SUBJECT: ED103 STATISTICAL METHOD-I

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.

firms with annual sales greater than Rs. 70000:

to be 60 and 15 respectively. Later on it was found that the scores 45 and 72 were wrongly
entered as 40 and 27. Find the correct mean and standard deviation.
